Benefits

Benefits of technical SEO services

Crawl budget spent where it matters

We clear the dead ends, duplicates and parameter traps so search engines spend their time on the pages that make money.

Faster pages on every device

Core Web Vitals and load-speed work that removes the friction quietly taxing your rankings and conversions.

Indexation you can trust

Every important page discoverable, crawlable and indexable — verified in log files, not guessed from a dashboard.

A better experience for visitors

Clean architecture, working links and fast rendering keep people moving toward enquiry instead of bouncing.

Visibility that stops leaking

Growth on a stable foundation

Technical health monitored continuously, so every content and link investment lands on a site that can hold it.

Challenges

Technical SEO problems businesses often face

“Google crawls my site, but the right pages still don’t rank.”

Crawl budget and internal signals decide which pages get attention. We re-prioritise both so your money pages are crawled, indexed and weighted first.

“New pages go live, but they never show up in search.”

Indexation fails silently — blocked resources, weak internal links, canonical conflicts. We trace the exact cause per page and fix it.

“Filters and parameters keep creating duplicate pages.”

Faceted navigation can multiply URLs endlessly. We control parameters, canonicals and crawl rules so one strong version of each page wins.

“Search engines waste time on pages that don’t matter.”

Log-file analysis shows where crawlers actually go. We redirect that effort to the pages that drive revenue.

“My site looks fine, but Google can’t read key content.”

JavaScript rendering hides content from crawlers more often than owners realise. We test what Google sees and close the gap.

“We redesigned the site and organic traffic dropped.”

Migrations break URLs and equity. We audit what changed, repair the redirect map and recover the lost pages.

“Mobile pages look fine, but rankings stay weak.”

Mobile-first indexing judges the phone version. We fix mobile rendering, speed and tap experience against real device data.

“Old URLs, redirects and broken links are quietly hurting us.”

Chains, loops and dead ends dilute authority. We clean the redirect estate and keep it clean with monitoring.

Our Process

Our technical SEO process

1

Understand business & search goals

We start from the pages and markets that matter commercially, not from a generic checklist.

2

Benchmark current performance

Speed, indexation and crawl baselines recorded, so every improvement is measurable.

3

Comprehensive technical audit

A 200+ point audit across crawl, rendering, architecture, structured data and log files.

4

Analyse competitors & opportunities

Where rivals are technically stronger — and where their weaknesses are your opening.

5

Prioritise by business impact

Fixes ranked by revenue impact and effort, so the first sprint moves numbers.

6

Build the technical roadmap

A sequenced plan your team can follow: owners, tickets and acceptance criteria.

7

Implement together

We pair with your developers — or implement ourselves — through staging and release.

8

Test before it ships

Fixes verified in a staging environment against the live baseline before they go public.

9

Monitor, report, optimise

Continuous monitoring with alerts, and a monthly review of what changed and what is next.

FAQs

FAQs on technical SEO services

How is a technical audit different from a normal SEO audit?

It goes deeper into crawlability, rendering, log files, indexation and performance — the engineering layer of SEO — rather than content and keywords.

Can you work with our developers?

Yes. We deliver developer-ready tickets with acceptance criteria, review staging, and verify fixes in production.

How long does technical SEO take?

An audit takes days, not months. Implementation depends on the backlog size; critical fixes usually land within the first sprint.

Will fixes hurt our current rankings?

Fixes are staged and monitored; anything risky is tested before release, and migrations include redirect verification.

Is technical SEO a one-time project or an ongoing service?

The audit and core fixes are a project; staying healthy is ongoing. Sites change with every release, so we monitor continuously and re-audit on a set cadence.

Which CMS and platforms can you support?

WordPress, Shopify, Magento, Webflow, Wix and custom builds — the audit is platform-agnostic and the fixes are written for your stack.
